name: Victoria Golf Club
location: Oak Bay, Capital Regional District, British Columbia
architects: laid out by the club's founders (1893, on the Gonzales Point / Harling Point shore); later work by the club, including an 1890s-1920s extension across Gonzales Point; architects of record not confirmed by the sources read

dtm.source: Natural Resources Canada HRDEM (CanElevation), project BC-Vancouver_Island_Sunshine_Coast_2018-1m (lidar flown 2018-2019), DTM 1 m, via the NRCan datacube WCS (datacube.services.geo.ca/ows/elevation, coverage dtm) as a GeoTIFF in EPSG:32610, CGVD2013 m; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31; open sea (nodata) filled from its rim by intake.py raster --fill-sea

dsm.source: Natural Resources Canada HRDEM (CanElevation), same project, DSM 1 m (first-return surface), via the same WCS (coverage dsm); open sea filled as the DTM
dsm.label: 2018-19 lidar surface model (NRCan HRDEM)

ortho.source: Capital Regional District 2025 orthophoto (mapservices.crd.bc.ca OrthoImagery2025 MapServer export, 0.5 m, EPSG:32610), fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31, placed by its request box with pipeline/intake.py ortho

world.note: OSM course boundary (relation 2579054) bbox 701 x 913 m in UTM 10N + scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred on the boundary: 1,024 m east-west (162 m each side), 1,280 m north-south (184 m each side); inside the HRDEM/ortho download box 477300-478550 E, 5361700-5363200 N

scorecard_source: The club's own printed card, 'Scorecard 2025' PDF on victoriagolf.com (fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31): Gold 6,157, Blue 5,899, White 5,574, Green 5,033, men's par 70 and men's handicap, women's par 72 and handicap; every row adds up to its printed totals. No rating or slope on the card (stored 0). Built: Gold (the tips) and Blue (developer, 2026-10-30: the furthest-back tees and Blue; Blue the default).
attribution: Elevation and trees: contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Natural Resources Canada, HRDEM)
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-30/31 (developer asleep, calls made and listed in docs/courses/victoria.md): standing defaults (every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar); tees Gold + Blue, Blue default; wind 3-14 mph (open coast on Juan de Fuca / Haro Strait); course-select state British Columbia (developer approved; the game's state list needs 'BC', a design-chat request).
red_water_note: the sea (proposed/sea.geojson, from OSM's coastline): a red penalty area wherever it lies (standing default; Cypress Point, Newport)
ob_highways_note: Beach Drive (highway=secondary, a public road) crosses the course between 3/12 and 4/11 and past 7/13: out of bounds (the club ended tee shots across it in 1923, club history page); a call for the developer
